queries_run: SoFi Technologies regulation OR regulatory scrutiny CFPB OCC 2026
SOFI SoFi Technologies DOJ OR FTC OR EU competition antitrust investigation 2026

findings.claim: SoFi 10-K（FY2025）揭露其受 2019 年 FTC Consent Order 約束，禁止在無可靠證據下向消費者誤述節省金額；並稱可能受政府機關審查、調查與裁罰。
findings.excerpt: Under the FTC Consent Order, we are prohibited from misrepresenting to consumers how much money they would save by using our products, unless the claims are backed up by reliable evidence.

regulatory_antitrust.note: 兩次搜尋未見 DOJ/FTC/EU 對 SoFi 的反壟斷調查或拆分報導；僅見 Muddy Waters 2026-03-17 做空報告與律所調查（非政府調查），未列入 finding。
